title: fix(console,i18n): delete the approval drawer's raw payload panel for every viewer (objectui#12490)
body:
Fixes #12490

Clause-②: no (narrowing) — the four locale keys `approvalsInbox.rawData`, `approvalsInbox.copy`, `approvalsInbox.copied` and `approvalsInbox.copyFailed` are retired from all ten `@object-ui/i18n` packs, so the exported `en` pack and `TranslationKeys` lose those four members and nothing widens.

## What this does

The maintainer dropped approvals face 4 and ordered the Approval Center side sheet's raw JSON panel deleted rather than ported (objectstack-ai/objectstack#23746 comment `6232118266`, relayed on the card at `6232139151`; verbatim 「业务上没有这个需求啊，处理审批的人为什么需要看json」). This PR executes that ruling in objectui:

- **`ApprovalsInboxPage.tsx`**: the drawer's collapsed "Raw data (JSON)" block (summary, Copy button, `pre` of the payload) is deleted for every viewer, a `studio.access` holder included. Its gate `maySeeRawPayload` and the gate's docblock go with it, and so do the three imports only they used: `usePermissions`, `holdsStudioAccess` and the `Copy` icon. `holdsStudioAccess` itself is unchanged in `studioEntry.ts`; `StudioRoute.tsx` still reads it. The structured summary, chain, activity, thread and actions are untouched. No replacement panel, flag, authorable key or served-page block.
- **Locale packs**: the four keys above leave `en`, `zh`, `ja`, `ko`, `de`, `fr`, `es`, `pt`, `ru` and `ar`. Same-leaf keys in other namespaces (for example other `copied` rows) stay.
- **Pins**: `ApprovalsInboxPage.rawPayloadGate.test.tsx` is retired and converted (git rename) into `ApprovalsInboxPage.noRawPayloadPanel-12490.test.tsx`, an absence pin: a `studio.access` holder (the old gate's only pass case) and three other principals (`setup.access`, a reported empty set, an unreported set) see no "Raw data (JSON)" label, neither audit witness, and no `pre` element, each with a business counter-probe (process label plus a summary value) so an empty render cannot pass.
- **Sibling test comments**: `ApprovalsInboxPage.hiddenFieldTrim.test.tsx`, `ApprovalsInboxPage.summaryFaces-11677.test.tsx` and `ApprovalsInboxPage.deadlineSettled-11815.test.tsx` justified their `setup.access` fixture by "the raw-JSON panel stays shut". Only those comments are reworded; no assertion or fixture changes.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/12490-drop-raw-payload-panel.md`: `@object-ui/console` patch, `@object-ui/i18n` minor (the key retirement is breaking for a typed caller; `minor` per this repository's version-alignment rule, `changeset:check` green).

The served approval request page is not touched; it never had such a panel.

## Mechanism assumptions, measured at `c4dd707`

1. **One render site.** Held. The panel was the one block gated on `maySeeRawPayload`; after the deletion `usePermissions`, `systemPermissions`, `holdsStudioAccess`, `maySeeRawPayload`, `Copy` and `clipboard` each count 0 in the page, while `toast` (12) and `selected.payload` (5) still have other readers and stay. The page has no other `pre` or `details` element.
2. **The four keys have one reader each.** Held, but **the named verdict cannot see it**: `check:i18n-dead-keys` treats `approvalsInbox.` as a whole-namespace dynamic head (the call-site gate's `DYNAMIC_KEY_FAMILIES` row says why: both wrappers are `tr(key, defaultValue)` open forwarders), so every `approvalsInbox` leaf reads as live to it, before and after. Its own report shows that head reaching 194 leaves at base and 190 on this branch, with the candidate total unchanged (351). The reader census was therefore done by hand over the only two `approvalsInbox.` translators (`ApprovalsInboxPage` and app-shell's `RecordApprovalsPanel`): literal `tr()` keys `rawData`, `copy`, `copied`, `copyFailed` occurred once each, all inside the panel, and zero times in `RecordApprovalsPanel`; no `approvalsInbox.rawData|copy|copied|copyFailed` spelling exists anywhere else in the tree.
3. **Other pins.** Only `rawPayloadGate.test.tsx` asserted the panel. Three sibling tests mentioned it in comments only (reworded above). No test mocks `studioEntry`, and none of the inbox tests mocks `@object-ui/permissions`.
4. **CHANGELOG.** `apps/console/CHANGELOG.md` mentions the panel as released history; not edited.

## Tests (all on `bec77e5`)

- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 apps/console/src/pages/system/ApprovalsInboxPage apps/console/src/components/StudioRoute packages/i18n/` through the verify lock: `Test Files 108 passed (108)`, `Tests 1479 passed | 13 skipped (1492)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- **Ablation** (fix committed first; mutation = the page's base blob checked out from `c4dd707`, on disk `maySeeRawPayload` 0 to 3, `tr('rawData'` 0 to 1; trap-guarded restore from `HEAD`): mutant run `Tests 1 failed | 3 passed (4)`, exit 1. The red row is exactly the `studio.access` holder, failing on the panel's summary element "Raw data (JSON)"; the other three stay green, as predicted for a panel that comes back gated. Restored: blob `394c5e9` equals the `HEAD` blob, `git diff HEAD` 0 bytes, `git status` empty, re-run `Tests 4 passed (4)`, exit 0.
- **Reverse verification of the type narrowing**: after `turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/console^...` (34 of 34 tasks), a throwaway probe in `apps/console/src` naming `TranslationKeys['approvalsInbox']['viaOverrideHint']` (control) and `['copyFailed']` made the console `tsc --noEmit` exit 2 with exactly one error, TS2339 on `copyFailed`; the control resolved. Probe removed, `git status` empty.

## Gates (local; exit code captured before any pipe)

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console type-check` 0 and `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n type-check` 0 (both script names echoed; console's tsconfig includes the new pin, counted with `--listFilesOnly`), `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm check:i18n-keys` 0 · `check:i18n-drift` 0 ("0 key(s) added, 4 removed") · `check:i18n-dead-keys` 0 (report-only; blind to this namespace, see above) · `check:i18n-designer-parity` 0 · `check:new-line-citations` 0 ("0 new citation(s)") · `check:test-path-roots` 0 · `check:changeset-claims` 0 · `changeset:check` 0 · `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` 0 · `check:control-bytes` 0 · `check:vi-mock-specifiers` 0 · `check:vi-mock-inherit` 0 · `check:vi-mock-override-shape` 0 · `check:pending-changeset-literals` 0.
- eslint on the 15 changed source and test files: exit 0, 0 errors, 19 warnings, all in `ApprovalsInboxPage.tsx`; the base version of that file linted through stdin gives the same 19 warnings with the same rule tally, so none is new.
- `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` over the changed paths: NOT GOVERNED.
- NOT MEASURED: `check:eager-locale-catalogues`, reason: it reads a built console bundle (`PREREQUISITE NOT MET`, exit 2); CI owns it. The full farm is CI's.

## Acceptance notes (observations, not filed)

- `apps/console/src/pages/system/hiddenFields.ts` keeps a docblock contrast with "objectui#5553's raw-JSON panel, which fails CLOSED", now about a deleted panel. It sits outside this claim's file surface and is left as is.
- The call-site gate's `approvalsInbox.` family reason prose states a key count ("169 keys") that its own sibling report already measured as 194 at base; it was a stale figure before this change and is not edited here.
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/DeclaredActionsBar.test.tsx` carries a cross-file line address into `ApprovalsInboxPage.tsx` that already pointed at unrelated lines at base; this deletion shifts it again. Not swept, per AGENTS.md rule 11.
- No negative i18n pin for the four retired keys was added (earlier retirement batches carry one under `packages/i18n/src/__tests__/`); the console absence pin holds the panel, and a key returning alone would only be an unread row.
